caption:
Tests turn "looks right to me" into a pass or fail you can check in seconds.

They also help the AI itself: agents can run the tests, read the failures, and fix their own mistakes before you even look.

Start small: one test per important user flow (login, add to cart, checkout). That alone catches the worst breakages.

Does your current project have tests?

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

#javascript #frontend #reactjs #nodejs #webdevelopment
altText:
An AI coding tool is only as safe as your tests.

No tests = no quick way to know if its "small refactor" broke checkout.
